concept:
指揮者は、いつも自分だった。 (The conductor was always you.) The film starts from draft 0, which most judges ranked highest. A grey copy-paste "thread" follows the viewer through two pains: tab-hopping between unbranded AI tools, and babysitting an agent that says 「できました」 while the tests fail.

The thread then untangles into Orchestra's own two-strand brand mark, and we enter the warm noir and champagne-gold world of the real Orchestra Dark UI. One request goes in: 「シンプルな TODO アプリを作って動かして」, the product's own example. The Leader (the conductor) sets a goal with two yes/no conditions and writes the score (📋 FLOW).

**FLOW is now rendered exactly as the code prints it.**
- It carries the 「ラウンド 1: 」 prefix and the 📂 準備 line.
- An unnumbered ファイル読み込み [準備・AI なし] step runs first.

**The relay, on a concert stage**
- Four cast seats (検索 → プランナー → コーダー) receive one gold baton, one seat at a time, never in parallel.
- Five uncast roles stay dim.
- Non-AI steps sit on the floor beside the podium: file reading and the npm test command.

**Order and the callback**
- The command card now runs before the Reviewer, which is the corrected order.
- The ❌ lands at the exact screen position of the pain scene's '✕ テスト失敗', but this time nobody calls the human.
- The Reviewer checks each condition. Two "goal tokens" (grafted from draft 1) fill gold ✓ or garnet ×.

**The goal loop and the payoff**
- The loop is a gold lap ring with a round odometer (grafted from draft 2, recoloured gold so red never means "error").
- Round 2 fast-forwards through illegible cards, so no step details are invented. npm test passes.
- On the 56 s hit: 「🎯 目標を達成しました（2 ラウンド目）」, with the .division/*.md files as proof.

**Two quick, honest nods to other differentiators** (each beat has at most three sub-beats)
- Cost tuning, in the correct order: the chip opens the panel, the switch turns it on, and the sliders settle. 「性能と料金を、調律する。」 comes from draft 2.
- /remote-control, sent only after the goal is met. The phone is a textless wireframe, and "LAN" hops show polling rather than real-time.

**The finale** answers the opening line on the 70 s final chord: 「指揮は、Orchestra に。」

**Fixes over draft 0**
- The product UI appears at 17 s, not 24 s.
- No timeline contradictions.
- No mid-run loop toggle.
- No overclaiming reviewer reasons.
- No invented window title.
- A nine-seat layout that does not collide.
- Camera speed limits.
- An emoji-font plan.
- Inter 400 for the wordmark, since Inter 300 is not fetched.

**Constraints kept:** 9 scenes, 76 s, cut to the unmodified promo/intro-video/tools/music.json.

scenes.purpose:
Global 0.0–12.0 (music intro 0–8, build from 8). Two pains in one cold world.
- Part A (0–6): AI tools multiply and you become the human glue, copy-pasting between tabs.
- Part B (6–12): you babysit one agent that says 「できました」 while npm test fails; the failure lands on the 8.0 s hit.
It ends on the thesis 「指揮者は、いつも自分。」, with the grey 'thread' that 02 untangles into the Orchestra mark.

- 1920×1080 at 30 fps.
- All text stays inside x 120–1800 and y 90–1040. Footnotes may sit at baseline ≤ 1040; everything else ≤ 990.
- UI panels may bleed past the safe area; their text may not.
- Layer order: backdrop < stage/graphics < UI mocks < captions < footnotes.

PALETTES (hex)

1) PAIN WORLD (01, and the start of 02 only). Defined in-scene, not in base.css.
- Background #0b0d12 / #12151d / #050608.
- Panels #161a23, #1c212c; user bubble #2a3140; terminal #0f1218; window dots #3a4150.
- Lines rgba(255,255,255,.08) / .14.
- Text #f3f4f7, #c4c9d4; muted #8a92a3.
- Generic alert #e5484d (deliberately not the brand red).
- No gold and no brand red in this world.

2) BRAND (02, 09, the 07 mark sweep, 'Orchestra' in the tagline)
- Mark gradient: transparent #5e0b16 → #8c1223 (90%) → #c01e31 → #d8283b.
- Arrowheads #d8283b; highlight #fff4f5.
- Logo #dc1428.
- Halo #e02431 (24%→0); red-hi #ff6174; text gradient #c9273b → #ff6174 → #e02431.

3) PRODUCT, Orchestra Dark (03–09). Already in lib/base.css and lib/ui.css.
- Surfaces: editor #0e0c0b; sidebar and titlebar #131110; input and panels #1a1716; hover and secondary #24201e.
- Lines: #262120; strong #3a3330.
- Text #ece6de; strong #f7f2ea; sidebar #bdb3a8; muted #877c72; fg-4 #8C8C8C.
- Champagne gold #c6a769 (hi #e3cf9f, lo #8a7449): progress, focus, the baton, success.
- Garnet #8f1d2c (hover #a5263a, text on garnet #fbf6ee): primary buttons, toggles, thumbs, the unmet token.
- Green dot #89D185; yellow dot #CCA700.
- Diff add #6fa287; muted rose #d27a82 (failure annotations).
- Syntax: string #cbb27a, keyword #d0808a, function #e6d3a8, type #9fbcaf, comment #6f665f italic.

COLOUR RULES
- Red is brand-only. It never colours UI chrome, failure states or the round ring. Failure uses #d27a82 or #e5484d (pain world only).
- Gold means progress or success.
- Never show the slate-and-white 'Modern' design prototype, real AI product logos, model names, the '38 models' claim, QR codes or URLs.

FONTS
- fonts/fonts.css via tools/fetch-fonts.sh provides Noto Sans JP 400/500/700/900, Inter 400/500/600/700/800 and JetBrains Mono 400/600.
- There is NO Inter 300, so every wordmark uses Inter 400 with letter-spacing .62em.
- Japanese: Noto Sans JP (900 captions, 700 emphasis, 500 body).
- Latin labels and numerals: Inter.
